name: Cockroach Poker
summary: A bluffing card game where players pass face-down critter cards with true or false claims to stick opponents with four of a kind.
rules_text: Shuffle 64 cards (8 types x 8 copies) and deal face-down evenly. On your turn, slide one card from your hand face-down to another player and declare its creature (truthfully or falsely). The receiver may: 1) Accept - say 'true' or 'false' about your claim. If correct, you must take the card face-up in front of you; if wrong, receiver takes it. 2) Pass - peek secretly at the card, then slide it to a different player who hasn't seen it, either repeating or changing the claim. A card may be passed until all players have seen it; the last player must accept. Whoever ends up with the card starts the next round. In 2 players, remove 10 unseen cards and no passing. Lose if you collect four of the same creature in front of you or you must start a round with no cards in hand.
rating_reason: pure bluffing offer with hidden hands, sequential lying game
